create_Qwen3VLConfig: create a Qwen3VLConfig instance with default vision and text sub-configurations for a Qwen3-VL model
create_Qwen3VLTextConfig: create a Qwen3VLTextConfig instance with default transformer parameters like vocab size, hidden size, and attention heads
create_Qwen3VLVisionConfig: create a Qwen3VLVisionConfig instance with default vision transformer parameters like depth, patch size, and hidden size
build_Qwen3VLConfig_from_dicts: build a Qwen3VLConfig from dict arguments for vision_config and text_config to initialize a Qwen3-VL model
review_Qwen3VLConfig_post_init: review the Qwen3VLConfig __post_init__ method that converts dict configs into Qwen3VLVisionConfig and Qwen3VLTextConfig instances
